name: Order processing
summary: A shop takes the payment, queues fulfilment, and parks orders the warehouse keeps refusing
useWhen: Learning how shapes, connectors, flows, notes and drill-down views read on the canvas.
A request must answer fast while slower work, like booking a shipment, happens after.
Sketching any queue-and-worker design with a failure path.
watchOutFor: Storing the order and sending the command are two writes; pair it with the Transactional Outbox.
Competing consumers process orders out of order; nothing here may depend on it.
A dead-letter queue nobody watches is just a slower way to lose orders.
